name: RER B
about: The RER B line (Ligne de Sceaux) across the map: its formation, tracks, catenary, platforms and stations (Lozère, Le Guichet, Orsay-Ville...), bridges, underpasses, fences, the yard's tracks; designed by tools/rail/build_rail.py (OSM, LiDAR) into world/rail.json, its ground patched into the map's files by tools/rail/patch_world.py, built by builder/rail_builder.gd.
